name: Room Reverb
purpose: Room reverb with clear early reflections and a short to medium natural tail; puts a dry vocal or instrument in a believable space.

expose.ai_hint: Dry signal level. Keep at 100% when used as an insert.
Early reflections level: the sound of the walls. 5-15%.
Reverb tail level. 8-18% for a natural room on a vocal.
Room size in metres. 8-12 small booth or room, 15-20 studio live room, 25+ large room.
0-20 ms; small rooms need little predelay.
Tail length in seconds. 0.3-0.8 s for a tight room, 1-1.5 s for a large live room.
Density of the tail. Higher is smoother.
Raise to 100-200 Hz to keep the room out of the low end.
Lower to darken what enters the reverb.
High-frequency damping of the tail; lower is darker and softer.

notes: Upstream symbol for the tail level is 'late_level'; exposed here as 'wet'.
Defaults come from the upstream default preset.
CPU: 1.66% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
